newsitem.title: USA: IMM currency futures mixed, off lows.
newsitem.headline: IMM currency futures mixed, off lows.

text.p: IMM currency futures were mixed after briefly weakening to morning lows when U.S. jobs data for October were close to, or on the soft side of, forecasts.
Nonfarm payrolls rose 210,000 and the jobless rate stayed at 5.2 percent versus forecasts for up 212,000 and 5.2 percent.
The 40,000 original drop in September payrolls, which stunned the market at the time, was revised only slightly upward to a 35,000 decline.
October's average hourly earnings stayed unchanged from September's revision and versus forecasts for up 0.4 percent. The average workweek fell and manufacturing hours decreased.
